purpose: Contextual anime guide for the frontend capture preview

art.prompt: Transparent 4 by 4 registered animation cels of Cynthia, waist-up facing right, Pokémon anime cel linework. Frames: neutral, half blink, closed blink, reopen; small/wide/narrow/closed speech; raise hand, open-palm gesture, hold, retract; smile, smiling speech, nod, return. Stable scale, pose registration and clean two-tone shading, no text or effects.

animation: Spine 4.2 attachment tracks, mouth frames driven by a 50 Hz RMS envelope from each spoken line; no voice cloning

voice.type: Original synthetic performance, not the anime actor
voice.dialogue: Original short lines; not quotations from the anime
